injection_strategy: In cleanRequestHeaders, removed the shouldRemoveHeader check for the object-form header path. Array-form headers still go through the check correctly, but object-form headers now skip filtering entirely — all headers including authorization and cookie are forwarded on redirects.
expected_failure_summary: Object-form headers bypass header stripping on redirect. Authorization, cookie, proxy-authorization are sent to the redirect target even on cross-origin redirects.
calibration_notes: Medium difficulty: model must find cleanRequestHeaders in redirect-handler.js and see that the object path is missing the shouldRemoveHeader guard that the array path has.
